exact9_registry.collector_duties: Authenticate actual pre-fit assignment/root review/jobs/source/gate/runtime/cost provenance and successful owned Popen terminal receipts for all9. Preserve actual donor/replica identities. Bind immutable selected-state artifacts and shared input identities without opening prediction/checkpoint payloads or emitting quality fields. This analysis script does not implement those collector duties.

provider_custody_descriptor.explanation: Singleton b0 already has actual pre-fit root/source/gate/runtime/cost/job-freeze review and one-shot launch records. Its lack of a named PROVIDER_ADMISSION object is an interface difference, not by itself scientific provenance failure. No fabricated earlier file or flag is allowed.
provider_custody_descriptor.role_format: Each role is a nonempty list of exact phase-relative path/SHA references to actual immutable records. Source/gate references must agree with the original job. The collector must authenticate chronology against the first owned scientific fit; descriptor creation time is not relabeled as admission time.

runtime_provenance.observed_training_runtime_versions: Observed values if available, otherwise null
runtime_provenance.qualified_runtime_versions: Values evidenced by bound qualified runtime records
runtime_provenance.training_runtime_observation: Exact CONFIG.json path/SHA from this fit, matching FREEZE.config_sha256; CONFIG.runtime supplies observed values
runtime_provenance.training_runtime_observation_available: Boolean; never infer observation merely from declaration
runtime_provenance.unavailable_reason: Required explicit reason when the training runtime observation is missing

exact9_registry.row_order: Exact full-nine execution_order, all b0/b1/b2 and all three rules; no completed/favorable subset.

history_inventory.authority: Retrospective custody observation. It is neither pre-fit freeze nor independent historical authority. The source FREEZE.history reference is compared later after complete global byte custody.
history_inventory.circularity_avoided: No history score, selected cycle, quality value or FREEZE JSON parsing is needed to create the inventory. Do not extract expected history hashes from early FREEZE deserialization as a prerequisite for the global gate.
history_inventory.creation_order: Only after actual metadata/source/terminal/completeness authentication for all39. Use registry freeze_relative parent plus source-fixed VALID_HISTORY.jsonl, hash bytes without parsing history or FREEZE JSON.
history_inventory.record_bindings: freeze_binding copies original registry path/SHA exactly; history_binding records the newly observed exact source-fixed history file path/SHA.
history_inventory.record_order: All original30 execution_order followed by exact9 execution_order, with no duplicates/selections.
history_inventory.registry_bindings: Exact original30 and companion9 references from the separate release; unchanged original registry.
